title: Playboy Magazine April 1972 Jack Nicholson Interview Michael Crichton Mustang
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning and soiling, heaviest along the lower edge, with corner wear and light creasing at the upper left. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. If centerfold presence matters to you, message me before buying and I will check.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, April 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- The Playboy Interview with Jack Nicholson, given at the height of his run through "Easy Rider," "Five Easy Pieces" and "Carnal Knowledge"
- Fiction by Herbert Gold and Michael Crichton
- The Poems of Mao Tse-Tung
- Donn Pearce, who wrote "Cool Hand Luke," on dope smuggling
- A Portfolio of Erotic Art
- Calvin Trillin and Roy Andries de Groot on the world's greatest restaurant

The back cover carries a 1972 Ford Mustang ad, "Control and balance make it a beautiful experience," showing the SportsRoof and Hardtop with the Sprint Decor Option against a surfing shot. A good one for Mustang collectors as well as magazine collectors.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
